# Pratik Palkar

> SEO & GEO Project Manager based in Mumbai, India, with 7+ years in organic growth. Leads generative engine optimization (GEO/AEO) delivery for 5+ clients and an SEO team at Growisto across D2C/e-commerce, B2B SaaS and BFSI, with earlier agency experience across a large automotive client portfolio. Designed and shipped a 13-tool internal AI suite for SEO and GEO workflows.

## Specialisms

Technical SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), schema and entity optimization, AI Overview and LLM citation tracking, llms.txt and AI-crawler access configuration, content architecture for LLM retrieval, internal linking, link building and citation outreach, CRO for organic landing pages, ASO, automotive SEO.

## Results

Client names withheld under NDA. Figures from Google Search Console and GA4.

- **D2C sports equipment brand, India:** non-brand organic clicks up 3.1x over 10 months, 8,098 to 25,358 per month, on a 39% impression rise, so non-brand CTR more than doubled from 0.42% to 0.94%; LLM-sourced sessions up 3.7x over 8 months, 686 to 2,531 per month.
- **Consumer energy brand, India:** non-brand organic clicks up 3.7x over 14 months, 4,600 to 17,100 per month, with 7,087 to 17,100 in the final three months; AI-sourced traffic up 12.6x, 87 to 1,100 monthly sessions.
- **Kids edutainment site, US:** a new site launched into the US market reached 4,065 monthly non-brand clicks and 251,623 non-brand impressions in four months, against entrenched category leaders; total organic clicks up 3.2x from 1,979 to 6,426 with brand traffic flat, so non-brand went from nothing to 63% of all organic clicks.

Across all three accounts, in different sectors and markets, non-brand organic clicks roughly tripled. Every account hit its agreed targets across the period.

## Built

The Growisto AI Suite: 13 internal SEO/GEO tools (5 live web apps, 8 plugins), scoped and built with Claude, using the Claude/OpenAI APIs, Bright Data API and Ahrefs API, version-controlled on GitHub and deployed on Render.com. Tools include an AI Overview Citation Scraper, a 106-parameter SEO Technical Audit, Competitor Analyzer, Seasonality Dashboard, Schema Audit, SEO Page Level Audit, Keyword Classifier, Backlink Shortlister, Internal Linking analyser, SEO Meta Tag Generator, Blog Content Review, Content Creator and SEO Potential Analysis.
